method.video_control: Full-frame PSNR and SSIM; no scaling/alignment; same PTS. Pair2 coding control ultrafast/CRF23/GOP250/18threads; optional postdecode Y-1, no additional encoding.
method.audio_phase_fit: Second-order RBJ highpass and lowpass at 48 kHz, Q=.707, a delay and real gain fit to complex Welch transfer. Coordinate search; frequency bins 70-10000 Hz with coherence>.5; weights sqrt(source power/max power). Estimates not recovered commands.
method.audio_controls: Same fixed filter and frozen current preset applied to both source clips before stereo/48k PCM output; no AAC encoding in these controls; positive delay included in PCM timeline; compare common-length mono average at zero lag.
method.audio_tail: Second clip 114-115 seconds; 4096-point Hann PSD/hop2048; tracking 100 ms windows using 65536-point zero-padded FFT over 15-22 kHz. The strongest band peak is not necessarily the added carrier in non-silent speech windows.
method.old_audio_local_alignment_correction: Previous report maximized signed positive correlation at +/-20ms; new probe maximizes absolute correlation at +/-100ms. Negative peaks are alignments of filtered signals, not proof of an explicit polarity-inverting filter.
